product_from_film: Bland AI automates phone conversations using a configurable branching conversation flow, with claimed connections to scheduling, CRM and payments.
explains_well: The call is paired with a conversation map that moves through introduction, explanation, integrations and ending.
unclear: The call explains possible integrations but never shows an appointment, CRM update or payment result.
scenario: Call the agent to ask how it works while viewing the conversation pathway behind its replies.
product_clear_basis: The ASR and visible captions describe people speaking to its AI by phone; the named phone call appears by 20s.

sound.detail: The draft supports the introduction, caller questions, broad integrations answer and website invitation. Several agent-answer sections are missing or garbled, including nonsense around 35s, so visible captions and node instructions support those scene summaries. No voice naturalness, interruption behavior, latency, music, effects or sync were heard.
sound.visual_relation: V01–V08 follow the call’s visible question and pathway structure.
sound.evidence: Local 513-speech.json with rejected garbled fragment; readable captions and workflow cards.

categories.finding: Founder introduction → agent call with pathway → ending → broader pitch and website.
The opening claim that viewers may already have spoken to the AI creates curiosity.
Phone-AI purpose is stated early; the phone and map make the form concrete by 22s.
The map reframes from whole tree to selected branch; purple node states change as captions progress. Exact transition timing and call latency unverified.
The phone persists as a close-up or inset when the workflow takes over the screen.
Dark restrained surfaces keep attention on the face, phone and pale node labels.
Enlarged node names explain the path; full-map text is too small for detailed reading at this scale.
Partial ASR and captions support the conversation structure, but the core voice quality cannot be assessed without listening.

categories.finding: The map and captions show conversational stages without sound; naturalness and response timing remain inaccessible.
Whole-map views establish breadth and close crops make the current instruction legible.
The central call lasts about a minute, allowing several conversational stages; the final pitch occupies roughly thirty seconds.
The agent completes its self-explanation and follows an ending branch; business integrations remain described rather than demonstrated.
The restrained founder presentation may suggest confidence, while the hiring tagline adds provocation; response unmeasured.
Caller requests correspond to visible introduction, pathway, integration and end nodes.
Call volume, future AI adoption, savings, integrations and live voice quality are unverified film claims; no funding figure is established by the inspected film itself.
Showing the branching instructions behind the call explains control of a phone agent.
Complete one integrated action.

lessons.keep: Pair the call with the current instruction and branch.
try: Show one integration through a final calendar or record result.
For Tin, connect one agent request to a visible branch and final output.
lessons.avoid: Treating the agent’s description of integrations as evidence they executed.
lessons.open: Voice quality, latency, live pathway sync, integrations and broad business claims remain unverified.

comparison.texture: Dark interview, phone and workflow UI.
